caption: Hidden Cat Cafe, Tokyo Japan🐱 We found this beautiful cat cafe in Tokyo’s upcoming neighbourhood called Kichijoji. Inside this area is a themed cafe called Petit Mura, its a quaint yet beutiful cafe to visit🥰 But the hidden gem is the cafe behind it called Temari no Oshiro Cat Cafe which is filled with gorgeous cats! 🎥Follow @nickandhelmi for more Japan travel and Japan food videos✨ 📍Temari No Oshiro, Tokyo Japan  . . . . #japanfoodie #tokyofoodie #placestovisit #tokyocafe #catcafe #japancafe #ghibli #tokyojapan #cutecafe #kawaiicute #petitmura #kichijoji #ghiblistudio #visitjapan #japantraveltips #traveljapan
transcript: This is a unique hidden cat cafe inside this Ghibli team building called Petit Mora, which actually is a little queen cafe with a facade that looks like a castle straight off a magical cat kingdom. But down the back, there's a secret door that is often overlooked that leads to this gorgeous cave like cat cafe. For whatever reason, it reminded me of those cave homes in Star Wars movies. But it would be the most hard warming session you would do here, especially if you love cats. Yes, there is an entry cost, guys, but you can admire the different cats inside. You can even order food, play with them as they roam around the caves. Just wash your head though, if you're tall. This is Temari no Oshiro Cat Cafe in Kichijoji, Tokyo, Japan.
